hooks.command: p=$(cat); case "$p" in *permission_prompt*|*elicitation_dialog*|*"needs your permission"*) printf 'waiting\n' >> "$CLAWHIP_STATUS_FILE";; *idle_prompt*) printf 'idle_prompt\n' >> "$CLAWHIP_STATUS_FILE";; esac; exit 0

statusLine.command: p=$(cat); f="$CLAWHIP_STATUS_FILE.line"; printf '%s' "$p" > "$f.tmp" && mv -f "$f.tmp" "$f"; if [ -n "$BETOOLS_USER_STATUSLINE" ]; then printf '%s' "$p" | BETOOLS=1 sh -c "$BETOOLS_USER_STATUSLINE"; fi; exit 0
